{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.0) or shows early negative signals.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >70% above recent peak) by applying a 10-15% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 5-10% for next 3 periods.",
    "Increase downward bias when true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days with forecast > true by >5%)",
    "For sentiment = 0.0, assume neutral drift; use 30-day historical mean as baseline, with ±2% volatility buffer.",
    "If forecast is >75% above historical 30-day max, flag for manual review and reduce by 20-30% to avoid overconfidence.",
    "When sentiment history shows 3+ consecutive 0.00, apply a 5% downward correction to avoid overestimation of bullish momentum."
  ]
}
